messages:
lina: Quick thread  Prism-9B (int6) brought through internal evals. Sharing short cost/quality recap and a conservative canary suggestion.
marc: Bench highlights: throughput +1.45x vs baseline (Nova-7B int8), token cost ~0.52x, composite eval +0.7%. p99 tail up ~18% on long-context slices.
priya: Slice detail: clear wins on FAQ/small-summary/heavy-chat. Noticeable regressions on multi-file code formatting and long legal-paragraph recall. We should avoid opening those funnels.
nate: Infra notes: int6 runs stable on H100; memory down ~7% which allows +20% batch density. Saw rare queuing when a mix of 8k+ context requests hit. Recommend tracing enabled for the canary.
lina: Proposed conservative canary (start low):
```json
{"model":"prism-9b-int6","start_pct":"8","max_pct":"30","duration_hours":"72","allow_slices":["faq","small_summary","chat"],"block_slices":["multifile_code","legal_long"]}
```
priya: Rollback triggers: composite_quality_drop_pct >= 0.5 OR any blocked_slice_drop >= 0.25 OR p99_latency_increase_pct >= 20. Also flag any customer reports for manual pause.
marc: Unit-econ quick calc for 500k requests/day @140 tokens: tokens/day=70M. Cost/day Prism ~ (70M/1k)*$0.40 = $28k. Baseline Nova ~ (70M/1k)*$0.75 = $52.5k. Savings ~$24.5k/day (~47%).
nate: Ops will start at 8% for 24h on allow_slices with verbose traces + token-level billing. Add model_confidence fallback: if confidence<0.65 on incoming code/legal requests, route to Nova.
priya: Product wants daily automated slice-eval results and a 24h longform replay after initial 24h window. If longform p99 stabilizes, consider expanding allowlist.
ops-bot: Canary started (id: c-2026-179999). Traffic=8% to faq, small_summary, chat. Monitoring hooks: slice-daily-eval, infra-trace, conf-fallback.
lina: Thanks team. Check-in at +12h and +24h. Will post live deltas then. :eyes:
